The scripts provide repository checks and regression tests. A failed tool invocation must not become an empty successful result; exit 77 names what could not run and is not a pass. Check that negative controls reach the intended failure.

scripts/validate is the manifest and scripts/qml-smoke.sh is the isolated runtime row. Never suggest qs -p shell against the live session or pkill quickshell; a second shell can black out the live desktop and other Quickshell applications share the session. The sandbox runtime dir must stay a short path under XDG_RUNTIME_DIR because Hyprland's socket path is limited. qs buffers redirected stdout; the per-instance log.log is the record.
